journey.name: scan onchain amount to confirm
journey.description: Verifies that an on-chain BIP21 request with an amount the Savings balance covers opens the Confirm screen directly, with the amount, recipient and fee filled in, and that the amount is fixed: tapping it does nothing, and Back from Confirm goes to the screen before it instead of Amount. Nothing is broadcast. Precondition: an onboarded dev wallet with between 200 000 and 1 000 000 confirmed sats in Savings, funded through the lsp regtest deposit and mine (see ../README.md), Coin Selection set to Autopilot (the default), no hardware wallet selected, and a regtest address the wallet does not own. With manual coin selection the link also opens Confirm, and the swipe opens the coin selection screen; see ../coin-selection/manual-coin-selection.xml. Start on the wallet home screen. The Confirm screen is identified by its "Confirm" title and the amount (testTag "ReviewAmount"); the Send Amount screen by its number field (testTag "SendNumberField").

actions.action: Run adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "bitcoin:<regtest address>?amount=0.0001" to.bitkit.dev

Verify the Confirm screen opens without the Send Amount screen (testTag "SendNumberField") having been shown, and the amount (testTag "ReviewAmount") shows 10 000, waiting through "Connecting to network" if it is shown
Tap Show Details (testTag "SendConfirmToggleDetails") and verify the recipient (testTag "ReviewUri") is the regtest address and Speed and Fee shows a fee
Tap the amount (testTag "ReviewAmount") and verify the Confirm screen stays open with 10 000 and the Send Amount screen does not open
Verify no toolbar Back arrow (testTag "NavigationBack") is shown, since Confirm is the sheet's first screen
Run adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_BACK and verify the Send sheet closes without sending and the Send Amount screen is not shown

Open Send (testTag "Send"), choose Enter Manually (testTag "RecipientManual"), enter "bitcoin:<regtest address>?amount=0.0001" into the recipient field (testTag "RecipientInput") and tap Continue (testTag "AddressContinue")
Verify the Confirm screen opens directly showing 10 000
Tap the amount (testTag "ReviewAmount") and verify the Confirm screen stays open with 10 000
Tap Back (testTag "NavigationBack") and verify the recipient field (testTag "RecipientInput") still holds the URI and the Send Amount screen is not shown; close the sheet without sending
Run adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "bitcoin:<regtest address>?amount=0.01" to.bitkit.dev
Verify the Insufficient Savings toast appears (screenshot) and neither the Send Amount nor the Confirm screen opens
Run adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "bitcoin:<regtest address>?amount=0.000005" to.bitkit.dev
Verify the Amount Too Low toast (testTag "AmountTooLowToast") says the minimum is 547 sats, and neither the Send Amount nor the Confirm screen opens
